definition: the gap between owning a capability and actually living off it

settled:
The garden is the clean case. Real capital and real landscaping went into it, and almost nothing off it reaches the table.

Building a capability and living off it are two different things. Harvesting and preserving is a capability of its own, and it has to be cultivated apart from the beds.

Not needing a thing has phases I had not named: built, operating, load-bearing. Owning the infrastructure gets me only the first of them.

title: Building A Capability Is Not Running On It
